description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed members of the Wages Boards for the Metal Quarry and Metal Crushing Trade and for the Dock, Harbour & Port Transport Trade for a period 03 years commencing from 15.08.2016
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists personnel appointments (named individuals) to Wages Boards for specific trades. It mentions the Minister's role in making these appointments but does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes. The content focuses solely on naming individuals and their basic roles (members, representatives), fitting the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette).
